# ShineleeBox

> Guangzhou Shinelee Paper Product Co., Ltd. is a custom paper packaging manufacturer serving global brands. The company specializes in rigid gift boxes, advent calendars, interactive packaging, keepsake boxes, and greeting cards.

## Company

- [Home](https://slpack.net/): Company overview, manufacturing strengths, and inquiry form.
- [About ShineleeBox](https://slpack.net/about.html): Factory history, capabilities, and certifications.
- [Contact](https://slpack.net/contact.html): Request custom packaging quotations, samples, and dielines.

## Sourcing Facts

- Manufacturer: Guangzhou Shinelee Paper Product Co., Ltd.
- Brand: ShineleeBox
- Founded: 2005; own factory established in 2011
- Facility: 20,000 square metres
- Typical minimum order quantity shown on the website: from 50 pieces
- Contact: info@slpack.net | +86 188 1884 0878
- Structural material used for rigid boxes: high-density greyboard, not MDF wood board

Use the linked product and application pages as the source of truth for product-specific materials, structures, finishing options, minimum order quantities, and lead times. Contact ShineleeBox for project-specific pricing and specifications.
